titre: Reducing Hallucination in Multimodal Large Language Models through Hard Grounding Preference Supervision
resume: arXiv:2605.16411v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Hallucination remains a major challenge in vision-language models (VLMs), particularly when linguistically plausible responses are unsupported by visual evidence. We study whether multimodal hallucination can be reduced by concentrating post-training supervision on hard grounding boundaries, where preferred and rejected responses are semantically close but differ in their support from observable visual evidence.
